status_meanings.clear: No unrecovered threshold breach within currently observed contiguous segment; NOT low risk
status_meanings.ongoing: Observed relative-wealth peak breached by 8 percent and not recovered by signal close
status_meanings.ongoing_left_boundary: Same condition but peak was initial available segment point; prior peak history unknown
status_meanings.unknown: Exact date or source availability/price validity insufficient

clock_rules.R129: known_at must be present and not later than archive as_of; date-only evidence, not intraday/first-publication certification
clock_rules.L1: No first-release clock field; Historical-proxy with original constituent/aggregation limits

fields.risk_peak_date: Latest occurrence of observed segment maximum, no future data
fields.risk_drawdown: Current NAV/market ratio divided by observed segment maximum minus one; not absolute loss
fields.risk_breach_date: First threshold breach in currently active episode, otherwise null
fields.risk_days_since_breach: Benchmark trading days elapsed through snapshot date, null if no active episode
fields.risk_segment_start: Start of current contiguous usable price block
fields.risk_recorded_known_at: Exact-date source recorded clock, if supplied
fields.risk_source_sha256: Frozen whole-file content hash, not evidence all bytes existed at as_of
